correctness.rationale: The integer signed cube measures annihilate all <=3-cell assignment events by an untouched-block involution. Exactly 54 cubes each have eight private squares, hence span an independent nullspace of dimension at least 54. Exhaustive modular elimination certifies at least 522 independent cubic and 576 independent quartic observation columns over the rationals; together the ranks are exactly 522 and 576. Two independently written exact programs recheck the 576 Latin squares and selected 576 columns over moduli five and seven.

value.rationale: A complete reconstruction threshold and explicit entire ambiguity-space basis for the classical 576-member order-four Latin-square design is a natural low-order harmonic identifiability invariant, not a random slice. The 54 signed 16-state trades reveal the structural information lost by cubic observations, while quartic marginals recover all distributions. It is not simply the known critical-set property of an individual square; exact rank and trade basis have a direct meaning for probabilistic mixture reconstruction.
